# DEV complaint tracking and directory refresh

On DEV build 2026-11-07T10:03:18.175586+00:00, the new exact complaint card is available in the four desk screens. The app asks for the tracking number and checks the complainant name before showing status, contact and date. It follows the server's can_open and can_appeal. The card and its help omit complaint text, patient details, findings and the outcome.

Admissions created fresh synthetic CMP-2026-00011, internal record 12. Quality acknowledged it with Nurse Hina as contact and Ops Admin as investigator, Ops entered findings and Quality recorded a synthetic outcome. All four setup results are saved. Before any appeal, Reception's tracking card returned Resolved and the full detail returned 403. That independent privacy probe triggered the terminal's permission refresh, which reset the test view before any appeal. The continuation therefore used that recorded refusal and entered the first appeal once. The request committed before the test lost its reply. The original key and body replayed and returned the same appeal. The card now allowed opening, the server returned full detail and appeal_received_by was the actual Reception user. The three other desks read the exact card and retained their own disclosure limits. All four verified missing-number recovery, contextual F1 and English and Urdu layouts at 250%.

The backend refresh also aligned the terminal's complaint assignment and people directory permissions with the current server. An Ops read-only journey confirmed access to its existing synthetic complaint and the active staff list. Incident screening explains its finalized source prerequisites in the empty state and handbook. The action register lists the previously implemented active department picker in the current contract and task map.
